scripts.sentry:release:new: npm run setup-sentry && node -e "const pkg = require('./package.json'); const release = 'org.StraboSpot2-' + pkg.version; const {execSync} = require('child_process'); execSync('sentry-cli releases new ' + release, {stdio: 'inherit'});"
scripts.sentry:release:finalize: npm run setup-sentry && node -e "const pkg = require('./package.json'); const release = 'org.StraboSpot2-' + pkg.version; const {execSync} = require('child_process'); execSync('sentry-cli releases finalize ' + release, {stdio: 'inherit'});"
scripts.upload-sourcemaps-ios: npm run setup-sentry && node -e "const pkg = require('./package.json'); const release = 'org.StraboSpot2-' + pkg.version; const {execSync} = require('child_process'); try { execSync('sentry-cli releases new ' + release, {stdio: 'inherit'}); } catch(e) { console.log('Release may already exist'); } execSync('sentry-cli sourcemaps upload --release ' + release + ' --dist ' + release + ' --strip-prefix . ios/main.jsbundle.map', {stdio: 'inherit'}); execSync('sentry-cli releases finalize ' + release, {stdio: 'inherit'});"
scripts.upload-sourcemaps-android: npm run setup-sentry && node -e "const pkg = require('./package.json'); const release = 'org.StraboSpot2-' + pkg.version; const {execSync} = require('child_process'); try { execSync('sentry-cli releases new ' + release, {stdio: 'inherit'}); } catch(e) { console.log('Release may already exist'); } execSync('sentry-cli sourcemaps upload --release ' + release + ' --dist ' + release + ' --strip-prefix . android/index.android.bundle.map', {stdio: 'inherit'}); execSync('sentry-cli releases finalize ' + release, {stdio: 'inherit'});"
scripts.bundle:ios: npx react-native bundle --entry-file index.js --bundle-output ios/main.jsbundle --sourcemap-output ios/main.jsbundle.map  --dev false --platform ios --sourcemap-output ios/main.jsbundle.map --reset-cache
scripts.bundle:android: npx react-native bundle --platform android --dev false --entry-file index.js --bundle-output android/app/src/main/assets/index.android.bundle --sourcemap-output android/index.android.bundle.map --assets-dest android/app/src/main/res --reset-cache && rm -rf ./android/app/src/main/res/drawable-* && rm -rf ./android/app/src/main/res/raw
scripts.bump-patch: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && bundle exec fastlane bump && npm run create-changelog
scripts.bump-minor: npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && bundle exec fastlane bump && npm run create-changelog
scripts.bump-major: npm version major --no-git-tag-version && bundle exec fastlane bump && npm run create-changelog
scripts.commit-and-push: git add . && git commit -m "chore: bump version to $(node -p \"require('./package.json').version\")" && git push origin master

scriptComments.bundle:android: Must be run with every build for android before deploying to PlayStore. Removed the --assets flag because of duplicates.
